question: Parliament has passed the Waqf (Amendment) Bill, 2025, with the Rajya Sabha approving it in ______ 2025.
solution:
The correct answer is __**April**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

• The **Waqf (Amendment) Bill, 2025** was passed by the Parliament of India in **April 2025**, with the Rajya Sabha giving its approval during this month.

• The bill aims to amend the existing **Waqf Act, 1995**, which governs the management and administration of Waqf properties in India.

• The approval from both houses of Parliament signifies the bill's importance in addressing issues related to the proper utilization and governance of **Waqf properties**.

• The amendment seeks to bring in transparency, accountability, and better administration of Waqf properties, which are often large and diverse in India.

• This legislation is part of the government's ongoing efforts to streamline the functioning of boards that manage religious and charitable properties for the welfare of the community.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__

• **Waqf:**

• The term **Waqf** refers to a permanent dedication of movable or immovable property by a Muslim for religious, charitable, or pious purposes, recognized under Islamic law.

• Waqf properties are managed by **State Waqf Boards**, which are statutory bodies established under the Waqf Act, 1995.

• These properties are often used for purposes such as mosques, schools, hospitals, and other community welfare activities.

• **Waqf Act, 1995:**

• The **Waqf Act, 1995** was enacted to provide a legal framework for the management and governance of Waqf properties in India.

• It established the Central Waqf Council and State Waqf Boards for the efficient administration of Waqf properties.

• The act also includes provisions for the registration of Waqf properties and their protection from encroachments.

• **Importance of the Amendment:**

• The amendment aims to address issues such as mismanagement, encroachments, and underutilization of Waqf properties.

• By strengthening the legal framework, the amendment seeks to ensure the proper utilization of these properties for the benefit of the community.

• It also emphasizes transparency and accountability in the functioning of Waqf Boards.

• **Legislative Process in India:**

• A bill in India becomes a law after it is approved by both houses of Parliament—the **Lok Sabha** and the **Rajya Sabha**—and receives the President's assent.

• In this case, the Waqf (Amendment) Bill, 2025, was approved by the Rajya Sabha in **April 2025**, following its passage in the Lok Sabha.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

• **Role of Waqf Boards:**

• State Waqf Boards are responsible for the maintenance, preservation, and development of Waqf properties.

• They ensure that the revenues generated from Waqf properties are used for the welfare of the community in accordance with the donor's intent.

• **Recent Developments:**

• The government has undertaken various initiatives to digitize Waqf records and protect Waqf properties from encroachments.

• Efforts are also being made to increase awareness about the rights and responsibilities of Waqf Boards.
